interface.longDescription: Use the Zendesk plugin, built on Zendesk Bridge, to investigate support tickets and customer context, review queues and service metrics, work with Guide content, and oversee Talk, Chat, and omnichannel operations all from within OpenAI. Zendesk Bridge Open EAP: To use this plugin, please enroll in the Zendesk Bridge Open EAP from Zendesk Admin Center > AI > External AI. Read the announcement https://support.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/11485591370650.
defaultPrompt: Which Zendesk actions are available to me?
Read my recent ticket, summarize the issue and prior work, flag gaps, and draft a customer reply for review.
Review open tickets, find recurring and solved similar issues, then recommend the next steps.

positive.prompt: Create a ticket for myself to claim a refund for the recently purchased iPhone. High urgency.
positive.expected_behavior: Create one high-urgency ticket in the connected Zendesk account for the iPhone refund request.

positive.prompt: List 10 of my recent tickets from my Zendesk account
positive.expected_behavior: Return the most recent tickets available to the connected account, with ticket details, up to a maximum of 10.

positive.prompt: Fetch my Zendesk ticket with ticket ID 1.
positive.expected_behavior: Retrieve ticket ID 1 from the connected account and return its details.

positive.prompt: List all my Zendesk users in my account.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the users accessible in the connected Zendesk account.

positive.description: List Help Center articles in a new account
positive.prompt: List all my Zendesk Help Center articles
positive.expected_behavior: Return no articles because the dedicated review account is new and has no Help Center articles.
